events.name: Initialise kinetic scalars from parameter places

metadata.purpose: Pattern A bridge: parameter places → spatial signals
Sweep entrypoint: vary INITIAL_NUTRIENTS ▢, Nutrients ○ inherits at t=0

events.name: Step Nutrients ▢ at protocol time (T3 Jarzynski)

metadata.purpose: NET Test 3 protocol: fires once when t > NUTRIENTS_STEP_TIME_S, sets Nutrients := NUTRIENTS_STEP_TARGET. Default NUTRIENTS_STEP_TIME_S=99999 disables it (>6h run horizon). Sweep with NUTRIENTS_STEP_TIME_S=3600 to activate.

metadata.description: One-shot Spo0A_P pulse simulating direct IPTG-induction of Spo0A* (Fujita Q3/Q4). Fires once when t > INTERVENTION_TIME_S (s). LOADING_DOSE=0 or INTERVENTION_TIME_S=99999 disables the pulse.
